content: {"phoneNote":"Phone hero is strong, but the page ends with the contact block (phone, address, e-mail) repeated almost verbatim in the footer right below it, and the two circular photos under 'Ljudje v ambulanti' sit unexplained and cropped at the slice edge.","desktopNote":"Desktop hero and timetable work well, but the services section leaves a large empty left column under the 'Samoplačniško' card, and the two clinic photos flank the team list without any caption or purpose.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Merge the dark 'Za termin nas pokličite' block and the footer: keep address, phone and e-mail once and leave the footer to legal data and links.","Fill the empty left column under 'Samoplačniško' on desktop (e.g. pull the two clinic photos there) and give the team photos captions or a gallery heading instead of floating them beside the names.","Shorten the oversized footer wordmark on desktop and the giant phone number so they do not compete with the hero headline."],"blockers":["Phone and desktop: the contact block (address, phone, e-mail) is repeated twice in a row – in the dark 'Za termin' section and again in the footer."]}
